verdict.rationale: The Snyk CLI runs locally from the command line (snyk-gh-1, snyk-gh-3). It offers `snyk secrets test` for hard-coded secrets (snyk-docs-66) and `snyk code test` / `snyk test` for code and dependency issues (snyk-gh-5, snyk-docs-67), so a developer could wire these into a git pre-commit hook themselves. However, nothing in the evidence documents a pre-commit hook integration or blocking commits. The only documented hooks are Snyk Studio hooks for AI coding environments, not git (snyk-docs-69). Missing for 10: documented git pre-commit hook integration (e.g. a pre-commit framework config or hook install command), staged-diff-only scanning, commit-blocking behavior or exit-code guidance for hooks, independent hands-on corroboration.
